lines.opener: *a white unicorn steps out of the dark and looks at you; a moment later, from nowhere, a single trumpet sounds*
lines.openerHostile: *the unicorn lowers its horn; a beat later, unseen drums begin to pound, slow and grim*
lines.like: *he pauses. Then, from nowhere, a soft fanfare plays* ...Yes. That was well said, listener.
lines.dislike: *a pause; then an unseen horn plays one long, flat, sour note*
lines.hate: *he shies away; a beat later every unseen instrument shrieks at once* No! *and the unicorn is gone into the trees*
lines.flirt: *a long silence; he looks at his hooves. Then, all on their own, the invisible strings play something embarrassingly romantic* ...I did not ask them to do that.
lines.join: *he lowers his head; a moment later the whole unseen orchestra swells* ...May I come with you, listener? I would like to play for you. Every day.
lines.demand: *he coughs, apologetically* Musicians are paid, listener. It's... it's only proper. For the concert.
lines.gift: *he presses a stoppered bottle into your hand; inside, faintly, a trumpet is playing* A little music. For when it's too quiet.
lines.thanks: *a pause; then a bright, grateful flourish of flutes* ...Thank you.
lines.letPass: *he steps aside, and the trees along the path bow you on your way*
lines.neutral: *he waits; somewhere far away, an unseen lute tunes a string*
lines.ai: *a pause; then a single, baffled kazoo note from nowhere* ...I do not know that word, listener.
lines.refuseJoin: *he flinches back; a beat later a startled cymbal crashes* Oh... no. Please. Don't ask me that.
lines.leaveNow: *he turns away; a long moment later the music follows him, fading into the trees*
